content: SATS validation studies (peer-reviewed): inter/intra-rater reliability is good (Twomey 2012), but accuracy at the desk is imperfect and directionally unsafe: Conti 2022 reported nurse accuracy 34.2% with 36.3% under-triage and 29.5% over-triage; Mould-Millman 2021 reported 30% under-triage / 13% over-triage; MSF Timergara reported 97% specificity but only 70% sensitivity; Dalwai 2017/2018 and Meyer 2018 found acceptable ranges in some settings (under-triage 1-9%, over-triage 13-49%). Implication for features: under-triage (missing a sick patient) is the dangerous error, triage is noisy, so a support tool must (a) never remove clinical judgement, (b) always show the evidence behind a level, (c) support re-check as condition changes, and (d) be auditable.
